suppress: strong modern funnel without a clear Axis opportunity
production.note: Qualified leads, attempted sends, delivered emails, replies, bookings, and revenue are separate metrics. Existing daily ceilings are ceilings, not send instructions. Begin with five verified recipients after all preflight gates pass.

experiment.assignment: deterministic sticky hash of verified lead identity
experiment.no_winner_rule: Do not declare a winner from opens alone or from a small cohort with zero verified replies.

copy_rules.authority: Introduce Bradley as an AI architect, without unsupported claims or invented business defects.
copy_rules.likability: One short, respectful, genuine question about where AI could help the business.

strategy.primary_offer: AI architecture, consulting, and workflow automation discovery
strategy.primary_message: Hi [First Name], I'm Bradley, an AI architect. I help businesses design practical AI systems to save time and improve operations. If you could use AI to improve one part of your business, what would it be?
strategy.subject: Quick question about AI and your business
strategy.secondary_service: Website audits and conversion improvements, only when relevant to a prospect's stated needs
strategy.send_policy: No sends without owner authorization and verified compliant sender footer; verify recipient, suppression, Gmail access, deliverability, and message ID.
strategy.response_routing: Classify expressed business needs; offer existing 15-minute booking link for qualified interested replies.
strategy.daily_lead_workflow: Source and deduplicate verified active businesses with publicly listed business emails and evidence URL; website audit is not a required qualification step.
strategy.measurement: Track sourced, eligible, attempted, confirmed sent, delivered if known, positive replies, qualified AI needs, bookings, opt-outs, bounces, and collected revenue separately.
